content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am using a [product_name] with [article_no], and when I power it on, the display appears entirely black. Pressing the buttons shows unusual symbols. Does anyone know how to resolve this or what might be causing it?

Hi, unfortunately, this suggests your [product_name] has an electronic issue. You can open the casing to inspect for obvious problems yourself or consider sending it for repair. If it's a new device, definitely send it for repair; but if it's older than two years, you may need to purchase a replacement.

Hello, In addition to what was mentioned earlier, the issue might also involve the firmware (but there is nothing you can directly do about the [product_name]'s firmware). Before replacing it, try uploading your program (if possible) and downloading it back. If you have a backup, try creating a simple program, download it, and observe if anything changes.
Hi, Is only the display malfunctioning, or are the I/O LEDs also off? If just the screen isn't working, it may be a display-specific issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a major display problem with a [product_name], reporting an unresponsive black screen and odd symbols when pressing buttons. Responders identified the issue as likely hardware or firmware related, noting that direct user repairs are difficult or not feasible. This situation highlights concerns about hardware reliability and limited user troubleshooting options for these kinds of failures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to display information properly and operate without major faults, as well as to receive straightforward troubleshooting advice or repair options when such problems arise.
